# Play — Compass Rose

- SudokuPad: [Compass Rose on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Compass Rose on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Both rules are native f-puzzles constraints: eight `arrow` entries that all share the circle R5C5, and `sandwichsum` clues. This is the same
format Rangsk's solver read when it confirmed uniqueness. I have not opened the links in a browser myself. If the eight overlapping circles look
odd, `grid.svg` in this folder is the reference picture.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
